title: About
meta_description: Our family's story, three generations in.
sections:
Three Generations, One Family Business

Started by Grandpa Joe in 1985 with a single lawnmower and a pickup truck.

Grandpa Joe started mowing lawns in the neighborhood as a teenager, just to earn some extra money. Forty years, one pickup truck, and a whole lot of grass clippings later, it's still a family thing — his son runs the crews now, and his granddaughter handles the design side.

We treat every yard like it's our own — because around here, it kind of is. There's a good chance we've already done your neighbor's.

1. 1985

    One mower, one trailer

    Bill Miller started with a mower in the back of an estate car and eleven regular gardens.

  2. 1998

    The second generation

    Bill's daughter Katrin joined and brought the planting side, which is now half the work.

  3. 2014

    A proper yard

    We finally stopped storing everything at home and took the yard on Feldweg.

  4. Today

    Still the same round

    Three generations, six of us, and a lot of gardens we have cut for longer than the people living in them.

Katrin Miller

Planting and design
